# Normalize a 3PL quote before you sign it.

> Compare a third-party logistics quote with in-house fulfillment costs, minimum monthly spend, and true cost per order.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
